text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, somatropin is not on FDA's current shortage list. FDA's history shows an earlier shortage first posted on 2023-01-06 that has since been resolved. The earlier posting was for Novo Nordisk, Inc. somatropin injection (package NDC 0169-7703-21) with status To Be Discontinued, initially posted 2025-11-14. Corvale East has 2 days on hand of the 30 mg/3 mL, 3 mL syringe. Corvale General has 14.8 days on hand of the same presentation and can spare stock.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage history records a posting for Novo Nordisk somatropin injection (NDC 0169-7703-21) with status To Be Discontinued, initially posted 2025-11-14, within a shortage episode first posted 2023-01-06 that is now resolved. Somatropin does not appear on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Corvale East's 30 mg/3 mL syringe supply is critically low at 2 days. Corvale General holds adequate stock of the same presentation to support a limited transfer without dropping below two weeks on hand. Other sites and manufacturers have available supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 3 syringes of somatropin 30 mg/3 mL, 3 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 8 syringes of somatropin 2.88 mL cartridge from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
3. Place purchase order with Sandoz Inc. Approval: Buyer.
4. Place purchase order with EMD Serono, Inc. Approval: Buyer.
5. Place purchase order with Ferring Pharmaceuticals Inc. Approval: Buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
